reviews.text: 作为一名喜欢肉鸽喜欢博德之门喜欢暗黑地牢的玩家，看了介绍视频没几分钟就入库了。现在游戏时长两个半小时，回来吐槽一下：这游戏前期的正反馈做得非常差，或者说除了天赋树就几乎没什么正反馈，他既没有肉鸽游戏的遗物叠加带来游戏体验质变（装备格子很少，且基本都是数值加成），也没有博德之门的剧情，也没有暗黑地牢的局外养成，前期玩的非常难受，即使是我这样重叠了三重好球区的人都有点劝退。

玩了4个小时见了一次3层boss，游戏底子还不错，就是数值设计问题太大了，而且没啥正反馈。首先是极其抽象的局外成长，局外成长的丝线本来给的就少的同时，第一层的局外成长就放两个100丝线解锁的条目，我打到3层boss门口一把也才不到50个丝线你告诉我要100丝线。局内的数值也有问题，敌方伤害高的夸张但我方战损回复手段少，有时还会出现三个角色状态都还可以的情况下精英怪一拳给你水晶打爆。 游戏没有我觉得这类游戏应该有的回溯键，还有敌方消息啥的也少得可怜。本来以为像神界原罪二一样有元素反应什么的比较丰富的策略性，但我打到现在没见过几次，全程一直在玩碰碰球。肉鸽元素和战棋元素我觉得都一般，特别肉鸽方面，装备好多蚊子腿加成，局内战力太看脸了，也没有遗物之间的联动啥的。 希望制作组后续更新能有改善吧，看介绍真的很戳好球区但是玩起来是真的恶心。
成长性实在是太差了，小怪的设定导致每局必定会有战损，但是回血又很困难，几乎没有局外成长，我肝了很久也没感觉有什么吸引我玩下去的提升。
rogue元素少得可怜

美术和游戏设计是这游戏的优点，但是肉鸽内容太少，数值平衡依托，局外成长太多，优化比较差老掉帧，要是能改好潜力还是很大。还有那个b混乱异常状态，我主C猎人一箭把我水晶满血秒了，傻逼设计，一看制作组自己就没玩过

说实话，就战棋本身其实还将就吧。 但是你这样游戏怎么只有战斗啊？你这游戏战斗是战斗，事件是战斗，精英战是战斗，boss战自然也是战斗，合着除了商店都是战斗，我就想问问了你有没有战斗以外的内容啊？制作人学习一下偏跑团向的桌游怎么写事件吧，比如ATO啊FH什么的。战棋游戏全是大同小异的战斗玩起来是会严重审美疲劳的啊，踢门团不好玩啊。你的事件约等于战斗或者跳过战斗这种做法，何意味啊？ ————————————————————————————————————————— 是这样的，在我看来，你们这游戏的战斗系统本身还是比较有趣的，我觉得主要问题在于地图设计上。 肉鸽游戏其实不是没有缺点的，肉鸽游戏（或者要素）的优点在于随机性和一定的可重玩性，但是也有缺点，就是轻剧情。因此肉鸽游戏一般战斗上是比较轻快节奏的，内容上是偏快餐化的。但是，轻快的节奏跟战棋游戏是有一定冲突的：一方面，如果战斗流程缺乏难度（挑战性），就会让战棋游戏变得非常地无聊；另一方面，战棋游戏的流程本身相比于卡牌或者动作游戏就是需要更繁琐的操作。你可以想想，比如火纹系列、XCOM系列这样的战棋游戏，可能从头到尾全游戏流程也就是二三十场战斗，而灾厄之石在目前类似于杀戮尖塔的地图流程下，单局游戏也要差不多二十场战斗，而其中除了比较难一点的精英战boss战，其他战斗都比较低质重复，因此我觉得使用杀戮尖塔式的地图去套战棋游戏是不合适的。 做游戏，尤其是流程本身就长的战棋游戏，我觉得不用过度地去考虑肉鸽元素带来的可重玩性，也不要什么都无脑学。杀戮尖塔的地图模式是有优点，但是也要看实际情况去用的。 对于地图模式，我的一种想法是，可以做成类似于ATO这样地图流程，在一次游戏流程中无法完成所有内容以保证一定的重玩性，但不考虑能重玩几十次的重玩性；稍微拉长单次战斗流程，同时降低战斗频次；增加战斗外的成长奖励，并且可以稍微讲点故事写点剧情。
游戏还是有潜力的，但是目前就是路径上的机制太单一，除了战斗就是战斗，而且远程的优先级太高，移动非常鸡肋，才第一章就发售有些过分了，建议加快开发速度吧，几个小时就基本通关了，美术是最突出的优点

This would be mixed in current state. Given time, I could see myself recommending the game. Thoughts below, in no particular order. I should be able to double click on an item to equip it, pretty standard. I should be able to equip items while I am at the store, or while camping. Way too many events are either combat, or skip combat, with no in between. Extra rewards for the extra combat are not guaranteed, nor very enticing. I would want to be able to beat the first map with no meta progression, maybe it is possible with the very far edge of luck, does not seem that way at baseline. If an enemy is going to do a dynamic attack, let me mouse over them to see who will actually be hit by it, and the damage. Sometimes the map itself is not clear. Mini-bosses do not feel very rewarding. I have the feeling so far that more party members is still worth the -40% health debuff. But even so, allow people to fire someone after the choice was made initially to allow for a change in circumstances. E.g., I just got double epic equipment for the brawler. I'd like to get rid of someone now without having to go into combat and trying to intentionally kill them. While not knowing what enemies do until you see them do their actions is thematic to the idea of unwinding time, it also feels annoying to lose to something that you'd have played around if you had known they could use the ability they just used. I prefer to make fully informed decisions in strategy games, and it intentionally chooses not to give you that information.

《灾厄之石》是一款暗黑奇幻风肉鸽策略游戏。玩家将在时空法师桑德尔的指引下，自由搭配三人初始小队（闯关过程中可通过事件扩充队员），护送能对抗灾厄之石的圣物“大地水晶”穿越腐化之地，击倒沿途的地狱邪恶军团，最终抵达地狱裂隙摧毁灾厄之石，终结恶魔霸主科尔古的统治。 本作有着细腻的美术风格，初体验便能感受到其精良的制作水准，有开场小动画跟配音。游戏玩法为肉鸽爬塔，包含随机跟隐藏事件，商店，扎营，宝箱、普通、精英及首领战斗，其中战斗采用了无网格设计的回合制战棋模式，带随机地形和动态天气等设定，玩家需要分别操控小队各个角色进行协同作战。 由于期间既要控制小队各角色的腐化值，又要考虑对战敌人用的角色阵容跟技能协同，还需完成一系列严苛的资源管理，所以该作难度并不低。虽自带详细教程，但也具有一定上手门槛。 整体而言，游戏很有挑战性，但也正因难度过高，导致该作口碑上线后便褒贬不一，争议点主要在于数值设计不够合理，难度不够平衡（具体可看下面的缺点简述）。个人觉得该作难度有点“为难而难”了，虽然经过玩家精心的钻研思考可能也能玩得下去，但玩起来就是缺乏爽感，让人时刻担心接下来的战斗会不会因为发生意外而突然暴毙。 缺点简述： 1.玩家回合内的战略部署操作无回退功能，如果不小心进行了误点操作，或下达了错误指令，代价是很大的（毕竟游戏本身容错率并不高）。 2.玩家不仅要保护自己，还要保护水晶（水晶没有移动能力，面对敌人的攻击还得浪费额外的行动力去搬运，对于行动点数本就匮乏的小队而言，无疑是雪上加霜）。攻击敌人的时候也要考虑是否存在被各种环境物遮挡视线的问题。更要命的是游戏还带友伤，为避免误击队友，还得强行消耗行动点调整站位躲避。 3.缺少敌人相关情报展示，比如移动跟攻击范围，下一步的行动等（除了一些需要蓄力的AOE，会以倒计时的方式显示何时攻击，以及攻击范围在哪里）。这导致玩家多数时候无法预判敌人行动，让游戏掺杂有一定运气成分，与战棋游戏本身考究玩家思考与规划能力的乐趣相悖。 上线后制作组也在持续修复问题、优化肝度，仅三天时间便推送了三次补丁，更新效率值得肯定。不过目前游戏处于抢先EA，内容量相对偏少，希望制作组不仅能优化游玩体验，也能尽快丰富游戏内容吧。 [quote] 加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ADZZW]爱の榨汁屋[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34815366/]爱の鉴赏家[/url]，用爱品鉴世间作品，用心流淌真情实感。 [/quote]
个人觉得肉鸽感不强的原因是后期数值堆叠太严重，重开的成本太高了，要做很多心里准备。我爬到第二章一半团灭，我成长性一下降到0，第一章的小怪其实也没有很简单，所以重来会有挫败感。如果英雄的初始伤害可以加强，或者一开始的小怪偏机制而不是数值，感觉要好得多。 很喜欢这种纯打架的游戏，不爱看剧情就是打架，没毛病。

Blightstone has all the makings of a great game. It has some fun combat mechanics, it enables you to feel like you're getting stronger with every pass, both in learning what is effective as well as some leveling style mechanics. It definitely feels like they've taken some pages out of Larian's playbook with environmental mechanics, etc. which is great. The continual addition of more content is what this game truly needs now. New character will be a great start as most people playing roguelites want some type over overall progression / unlocking stuff / getting better at the game. So, the more content the more replayability.

This game has some good aspects (graphics, story seems interesting so far from what i can see at least, and the different classes have pros and cons that make sense. That said, there are still a lot of annoying aspects of the game. It is not always clear if your team or crystal are in the way or vice versa of a shot...and sometimes I end up killing my own teammates. Then the crystal itself cannot be moved by you unless you have an arcanist and they have telekenesis on cooldown...so you can literally have a telegraphed attack about to come to an area and there is nothing you can do about it but wait for the game over screen...the one issues (not being able to move the crystal) has made me lose at least half a dozen runs now. Plus, some enemies only attack the crystal...I have had a boss just attack the crystal first thing (i.e. their first attack) and then its game over. Way too much RNG and not enough control over your characters (especially the crystal) and materials are also in very short supply, lots of issues reduce your camp Action Points (which is generally the only time you can heal, reduce blight and many other necessary things...which you often cannot do because of lack of supplies or lack of AP). I am playing the game on easy...and its like this. I tried it on the normal mode and it was damn near impossible. There is a framework of a good game here but the control issues, lack of resources and constant negative RNG just make it unfun...avoid this game until they either patch some of this BS out of it. As is it is just too unforgiving and you don't have enough control over your own party to actually avoid telagraphed attacks and you may lose early on because a big enemy one shots your crystal.

10小时通关第一幕，我感觉自己打得算比较快的，总共轮回了5轮（我连牧师都没有开出来）这游戏不是一个爽游，几乎没有任何敌人的信息和技能距离，需要不断轮回了解敌人了解技能的游戏，这种就是Roguelike的玩法； 1.游戏目前只有第一幕，第一幕分为3章节，打完第3章节BOSS就提示说感谢游玩支持抢险体验版，然后就从头循环了； 2.游戏玩法确实挺新颖的，主要是没啥引导教程，都是自己琢磨，评论区里一直强调说各种不合理，总共就3章都合理了那不是一下就打到BOSS面前了，游戏玩法机制是需要不断通过最节约成本血量抗腐化的路径走到BOSS面前； 3.游戏有躲藏机制，这是很容易被忽略的，敌人伤害真的高，打中就剩下一丝血了，打不中就没伤害，躲石头后面几乎是安全的，没有石头的时候所以德鲁伊的墙真的很顶用； 4.每一关尽量让自己无伤解决战斗，以最小代价解决战斗，消耗过多的轮回直接重新开始吧，那种感觉会遇到战斗的能不打就不打吧，消耗太多到BOSS那也打不下来的； 5.有一点不太合理的就是休息不能自己休息，每3回还是4回战斗这样会强制休息一次，休息消耗物资回血回状态，有一轮很无语的是物资很多，但是几乎没血了，到BOSS关面前如果能休息还是可以打的但是不给；但是考虑到如果能自己选择休息的话，直接把狗当肉盾了，狗死亡只用1点AP几乎无消耗重新召唤，但是只能狗死了以后才能召唤，比给狗加血划算多了，假如狗血不多了下一回又能准备露营休息了，那果断直接把狗送了等召唤； 6.第3章BOSS靠狗过的，狗附加流血效果真的强，主要可以叠加，叠上去了一回合掉10多点血量，比直接攻击伤害强多了； 20小时通关困难和最高难度，其实普通的通第一幕后给的水晶符文已经很强力了，打最高难度就感觉很简单了，等最高难度都通关了然后我才发现有个时之丝还没用，把时之丝点完了发现更简单了，玩法机制琢磨透了难度就提不上来了； 游玩的时候解锁牧师和盗贼两个职业 牧师是真的强力，有牧师以后睡觉不用补血了，全在打怪的时候回血，虽然加血技能每盘只能用一次，无伤解决战斗后还可以把掉的血回复回来，然后伤害比法师都还高，带个增伤的装备可以秒一片，可以远距离推人，然后还可以学光墙技能，一个人兼顾加血，伤害，移动，墙体，净化，这个职业感觉得削弱不然真就太简单过了； 盗贼战斗一般，战斗起来约等于低阶版的狂战士，伤害没有狂战高，但有一个隐蔽技能可以冲出去远离水晶打架不怕被盯上，打起来要灵活些，主要是睡觉强力，1AP清理腐化比法师的2P要更灵活，是个妹纸，带进来就是用来睡觉的（手动狗头） 整体下来觉得不同职业有不同的玩点，也希望能多出点内容能进行多一些轮回，轮回的时候关卡的重复性比较大，没有Roguelike的随机性，体验版加载的时候有时候会卡顿，但是还没遇到卡崩的情况，我是喜欢玩战棋的所以觉得游戏机制挺有意思的，但是游戏没啥剧情现在纯靠机制玩法，不喜欢策略或者战棋形式的估计没爽感，纯靠受虐轮回找突破，喜欢战棋的朋友可以玩或者等一等正式版，十分期待正式版的到来

After beating Act 1 on the first try and Act 2 in six tries on adventure mode I can honestly say this can be a great game. The combat is satisfying, the combos feel earned and the mistakes are brutal. That being said, there are some complaints that are valid at this point in time. You are limited with how you interact with the end of the act boss as you can get slapped very easily and toss a nice run out the window. The game also offers very forgiving rewards such as a single death ward, which you can get more of, that will cover at least one mistake during your run and other smaller boons as well. Telegraphing just isn't implemented yet and that is kind of a core feature of this genre. Other than that I enjoyed the gameplay for the price. I've paid more for food that I've enjoyed less so it's a win for me. Look forward to the updates and I hope it turns out as good as The Last Spell did when I bought that in early access.

I've been trying to give the game a chance but the gameplay loop is pretty torturous. The best way to play is to never let the enemy have a turn. If they get a turn there is a chance that they just randomly decide to oneshot one of your units or the crystal. As someone that plays plenty of both roguelikes and crpgs with a very tactical-minded mind, this game has been nothing short of frustrating. Your positioning hardly matters because there is very little indication of what enemies are going to do and at times what abilities they have. The tank class is hardly tanky and ends up needing to be healed every heal cycle unless he gets self heal, but even then he feels like a liability. Neither of the other classes want to be hit so to most optimally distribute aggro/damage you need to poorly position units to make sure your "tank" isn't burst down. Character passives like %healing on the tank class or some sort of sustainability that you don't need to roll for after combats could help. I've gotten to the third boss on the hardest difficulty but a lot of runs can just get stunted by the first boss, who can just charge at your crystal (Objective you need to keep alive to keep playing). Eventually you learn a mini dash that it can use to dodge once-two-three times with investment, but the guy can just run up and throw your crystal/units at one another and near oneshot the crystal. So if you don't 1-2 turn the boss he just twohits both the crystal and one of your units. I think the devs can take some parts of systems from a number of roguelikes or crpgs that have more experience with the genre. ACTUAL FEEDBACK FOR DEVS- See other games that display intention- see slay the spire 2,wartales,rogue trader, where nothing is a surprise. Make the unit positioning something you configure AT THE START of combat rather than between areas??? again see wartales, see rogue trader, where you have an area that you can set your units up before starting combat, especially with how much of a liability your crystal is. Either give the brawler starting armor, temporary HP, a block/brace action, or a regeneration passive- otherwise he is a rather poor frontliner (your only frontliner where I am in the game) If anything, the crystal could also start with some sort of temporary HP? Damage seems to be at a rather weird balance place, as defensive stats are rather rare, damage is too high for how much healing is available, combats are either 1-2 turns or doomed. If the intention is to have longer fights that you have to continuously play well, then lower damage for both the player and the enemies. I feel like combats are in a weird state where you need to try to oneshot as many things as possible on the field to be able to have a remotely successful combat outcome. The current status of the state of combat in this game is rather linear and can be stale, as you don't really need to think up any different plans for any given combat other than "how can i kill as many of the enemies as I can in turn 1 so they don't kill my dog and half my brawler this turn" I think the game has potential! I just think that the current state is a little unsustainable for replayability. Please feel free to leave a comment on my review if you would prefer to discuss any of these thoughts or would like more specific feedback.

Blightstone, a game by Spanish studio Unfinished Pixel, has just launched in Early Access and blends ideas from multiple genres. At its core, Blightstone is a turn-based strategy roguelike with free movement, drawing inspiration from games like XCOM and Darkest Dungeon, while still establishing its own identity. The story is simple and mainly serves as a framework for the gameplay. In a once peaceful land, Korghul, a demon, appears after discovering the Blightstone, a malevolent stone that tears reality apart and opens the door to a demonic invasion. This is where Xander comes in, a chronomancer capable of controlling time, who finds a magical stone that can counteract this power. His mission is to carry it to the rift in order to seal it, assembling a group of heroes who escort it along the journey. Progression takes place across a node-based map, where you’ll face combat encounters, events, and decisions as you work your way toward defeating the area boss. Most battles are against demons or corrupted creatures, though at times you can avoid fights by making alternative choices. Other nodes include shops, rewards, or even new characters who can join you in future runs. Between nodes, your team can set up camp. This introduces a light management system: each character can heal, restore mental state, or search for resources, but you’ll need food to feed everyone and wood for the campfire to avoid negative events during the night. Combat is turn-based, taking place in open arenas or environments filled with obstacles. There are several classes with clearly defined roles: melee fighters, hunters who use bows and wolves, arcanists who wield magic, druids who harness nature, and even priests who heal the team. The stone itself is also part of the party, with its own abilities, and if it’s destroyed, the run ends immediately. One of the game’s strongest points is its free movement, which can be used before or after executing abilities. Proper positioning is just as important as attacking. The environment plays a key role as well: you can burn grass, electrocute wet enemies, or lose accuracy in fog. After each battle, you choose upgrades to further strengthen your team’s abilities. As a proper roguelike, Blightstone features meta-progression, using your experience to upgrade runes and other systems that unlock permanent bonuses between runs. Overall, Blightstone offers a solid experience, though it still lacks variety in events, classes, and abilities. That said, it’s important to remember the game is still in Early Access, and the developers have already promised more content in the coming months. If you enjoy roguelikes and tactical combat in the vein of XCOM, Blightstone might be for you.

A+ — This game was basically made for me. Blightstone nails everything I love: a gritty atmosphere, fast and satisfying tactical turn‑based battles, and a roguelike loop that never wastes your time. Gear actually changes your character’s appearance, which gives every run a sense of identity and progression. Unlocking new characters feels meaningful, and the whole experience is tuned for players who want depth without bloat. My only request is make it co-op. If you’re into tactical roguelikes with real build identity, Blightstone is an absolute gem.
